definitions.name: Sree
definitions.description: Sree is a multi disciplinary leader and Head of Project Management Office at Trimble. She is dedicated to empowering every person in Trimble to innovate by fostering a culture of execution and excellence everywhere. She truly believes what we do everyday is what we do with our lives! Her superpower is leading teams, from dreaming to doing and intention to action. Her passion lies in creating an environment that nurtures a culture of curiosity, modernizing and simplifying the complexities of technology to solve some of the big industry challenges of our times. She is truly an asset to the SketchUp team.
